messages.subject: [SPS-WARNING] essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable
parts:
I am a new user of R-SWAT and I am having problems with my case, so I am leaving you a description of what I am performing and see if there is something I am doing wrong.

I performed the example cases for SWAT, and SWAT+ with no problems. However, I notice that for my case it failed to have variation of the parameters selected in the Section 2. 

With the parameters selected for my problem, or those taken from the example. Here is a case of 10 simulations to illustrate the problem, I have tried up to 100 but I still get the same result.

For Section 3, I am running it as follows. Initially I am calibrating for flow rate. The channel to calibrate and validate is 3.  And the simulation report seems to be fine.
 

But when I go to section 4,
 
I get these results. Where there is no variation or convergence to the objetive function. I don't understand this. What am I doing wrong?

In the Section 4.2, due this results the program warns me: [SPS-WARNING] essentially perfect fit: summary may be unreliable

And the results, of course, are not reliable.

I appreciate your help,
Regards, Alejandro
